Name: Mineral and Gem Crops
Author: rearda88
Description:
Two years ago, during expedition to the unknown cave in Northend with researchers from the city, Clint discovered a plant that could produce minerals and gems.

Research began, and now the plant can finally be cultivated!

==========

Add crops that produce mineral and gem.

For now all crops only can grow in winter, but later i will add more crops that can grow in spring -- fall.

You can buy seed and tree sapling in Clint.

==========

This mod need the latest version of SMAPI, json asset and spacecore.

==========

How to install: just drag file to mod folder.

===========

Credit to Mizu for the sprites.
